purpose: Keep the public Ask the Model landing page consistent with the implemented application/provider/model/repository boundary while preserving a first-time-user path and clear developer routes.

suite_visual_identity.note: AtM intentionally carries user/developer action routes because it is an installable application and a repository-grounded interface.

implemented_capabilities: provider-managed model enumeration and completion-capability filtering
exact-SHA repository refresh and explicit download/update
compact numbered citations with inspectable exact-SHA provenance
loopback-only provider addressing in the current provider implementation
required_boundaries: AtM is the interface; the local provider runs the AI model.
AI model files are separate artifacts and must currently be downloaded/managed outside AtM.
AtM discovers models through the provider; it does not scan arbitrary disks for GGUF files.
The v0.3.0 repository catalog is fixed to EWD, CBD and RMD; repository manifests cannot add arbitrary origins.
Scientific repositories remain authoritative for their code, data, assumptions, provenance and validation.
READY means AtM-compatible local snapshot/index, not scientific certification.
AtM must not present AI-generated text as a canonical scientific-model result without repository-grounded provenance or actual model execution.

release_vs_development_boundary.public_release: v0.3.0 deliberately exposes the fixed EWD/CBD/RMD repository-aware grounded-chat path.
release_vs_development_boundary.development_main: Future work may extend retrieval, provider support, persistence or repository management without silently broadening the v0.3.0 release claim.
release_vs_development_boundary.readme_rule: README statements about repository retrieval must match released behavior and keep scientific validity/model execution boundaries explicit.
